IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_HelpEm: Scald milk (20 minutes at 85 C) in a Stone Hearth's cauldron, or in a pot on a lit stove or fire, and pour it in, up to 5 L: from a cauldron within 2 tiles, or carried in any container (only a Wrapped Yogurt Pot keeps it hot on the way). Add a yogurt or a starter. Once it has cooled to 45 C the incubator is wrapped and the milk sets by itself.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Starte: Starter in: the incubator is wrapped once the milk is down to 45 C.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoStar: No starter yet. Add one before the milk drops below 40 C.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NextTo: Too cold for a starter in about %1
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NeverS: Too cold here: it won't set while the temperature holds.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoChan: Nothing changes while the temperature holds.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Jars: Fills %1 glass jars or %2 clay jars, or %3 Empty Yogurt Containers.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_HasSta: This batch already has its starter.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_TooCol: Too cold: reheat the milk. Pour it out into a container and back into a Stone Hearth's cauldron, or top it up with milk steaming from the cauldron.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Wrappe: The incubator is wrapped and setting. Leave it be.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoStar: You need a yogurt, a Jar of Yogurt with a whole portion left, or an Active Yogurt Starter, none of them gone off.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Starte: One per batch. It can go in before the milk or while it cools.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_JarSta: Takes one portion, as much as a Yogurt cup holds. The rest stays in the jar, and the empty jar comes back with the last.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoCont: You need an empty pot or other fluid container.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoJar: You need an empty Clay Jar or glass jar.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_CrockH: Load 20 wheat grains and half a litre of milk at 35 to 45 C, from a cauldron within 2 tiles or a container you carry (a Wrapped Yogurt Pot keeps it warm on the way). The grain cultures best at 25 to 35 C: keep it by the fire in winter. Or load half a litre of soured milk alone, no wheat, warm or cold: it skips the grain's day.
The culture has taken. Feed it half a litre of fresh milk, warm or cold, and it develops into starter.
Two Active Yogurt Starters. Each sets one batch in the Yogurt Incubator. Use them within a few days.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_CrockS: Too cold here: the culture has stopped. Move it somewhere warmer.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NextWa: Ready for fresh milk in about %1
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_CrockN: You need half a litre of milk in one container.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_LoadHe: Takes 20 wheat grains and half a litre of milk at 35 to 45 C. Hotter kills the grain's culture.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_InfoSe: wrapped at %1 C, starter above %2 C
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_InfoAs: Times assume the temperature here holds.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoEmpt: You need an Empty Yogurt Container. Every yogurt you eat leaves one.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_CrockT: Too cool for the grain at %1: it needs 35 to 45 C. Warm it in the cauldron.
Too hot for the grain at %1: it needs 35 to 45 C. Let it cool first.
Less than half a litre of milk.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_CrockN: You need half a litre of milk at 35 to 45 C, from a cauldron within 2 tiles or a container you carry.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Clabbe: Clabber: half a litre of soured milk, warm or cold, needs no wheat. It already holds the bacteria the grain would grow, so the crock waits for fresh milk at once.
You need half a litre of soured milk in one container. Raw milk sours in about a day and a half in a warm room; scalded milk never does.
Rotten milk would only spoil the crock. Pour it out.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoHear: No cauldron within 2 tiles. Build a Stone Hearth (Masonry), fit a Forged Cauldron on it and bring the milk to the steam in that.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Cauldr: The milk in the cauldron is at %1 C: it must steam (85 C). Keep the fire lit.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Hearth: For yogurt: milk held at 85 C for 20 minutes pours into a Yogurt Incubator within 2 tiles, or carry it in a Wrapped Yogurt Pot, which keeps it hot. Milk at 35 to 45 C loads a Starter Culture Crock.
Only milk pours into an incubator or a crock. Fill your own containers from it.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NotSca: Not scalded: hold the milk at 85 C for 20 minutes first, in a Stone Hearth's cauldron or on a stove or fire.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_ColdFo: Too cold at %1 C: the starter is in, and this would leave the pot too cold to set. Reheat the milk in a Stone Hearth's cauldron first.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoMilk: You have no container of milk.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Scalde: Scalded milk (20 minutes at 85 C or more: a Stone Hearth's cauldron, a stove or a fire) in any container. It goes in at the heat it has now: an open pot cools in minutes, a Wrapped Yogurt Pot in hours.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Cauldr: The milk is steaming, but not scalded yet: hold it at 85 C for %1 more minutes. Keep the fire lit.
